description: A wide 16:9 figure with three equal panels side by side, each a large rounded rectangle with a short header at its top. Labels as plain text, no brackets. LEFT panel header 'Chatbot'. Inside: a small box 'message' with an arrow to a box 'model' with an arrow to a box 'reply'. Under it a single line of small grey text: 'one answer, no hands'. MIDDLE panel header 'Workflow'. Inside: four small boxes in a fixed vertical chain joined by down arrows: 'raise request', 'wait for approval', 'create order', 'release'. Under it small grey text: 'the path is fixed in code'. RIGHT panel header 'Agent', drawn with a sky-blue outline and the lightest sky-blue fill, slightly emphasised. Inside: a box 'model' in the centre; to its right a box 'tools'; a curved arrow from 'model' to 'tools' labelled 'act', and a curved arrow back from 'tools' to 'model' labelled 'observe', forming a loop; under the model a wide flat box 'state' joined to the model by a short line. Under it small grey text: 'the model picks the next step'. Below all three panels, one thin line of text centred: 'agent = model + tools + loop + state'. The left two panels are neutral light grey; only the Agent panel uses sky blue.

A wide 16:9 figure of one reasoning loop. Labels as plain text, no brackets. In the centre, three large rounded boxes arranged in a triangle and joined clockwise by thick curved sky-blue arrows: top box 'Thought' with a smaller line under it 'reason about what is known', bottom-right box 'Action' with a smaller line 'call one tool', bottom-left box 'Observation' with a smaller line 'read what came back'. The arrow from Observation returns to Thought. From the Thought box a separate straight green arrow leaves to the right to a box 'Final Answer' with a smaller line 'reply to Kavita'. On the far left, a box 'Kavita asks' with an arrow into Thought. Beside each loop box, a small grey example card in monospace text: next to Thought 'how long will the gaskets last? check the stock'; next to Action 'check_stock  item_code GSK-SIL-05L'; next to Observation 'free 66,000  cover 11 days'. Clean, airy, generous spacing.

A wide 16:9 two-column mapping figure. Labels as plain text, no brackets. Column headers at the top: left 'ReAct written as text', right 'Native tool calling'. Four rows, each row a pair of rounded boxes, left and right, joined by a thin horizontal double-headed arrow. Row 1: left 'Thought: ...' right 'assistant message, its text'. Row 2: left 'Action: create_purchase_request' plus a second line 'Action Input: {...}' right 'assistant tool_calls: name and arguments'. Row 3: left 'Observation: {...}' right 'tool message: the result'. Row 4: left 'Final Answer: ...' right 'assistant message with no tool calls'. Left column boxes are light grey with monospace text; right column boxes are light sky-blue with monospace text. At the bottom across both columns a thin banner: 'the same loop: your code parses text, or the API returns structured calls'.

A wide 16:9 architecture figure of an agent harness. Labels as plain text, no brackets. In the centre, a box 'model' with the lightest sky-blue fill. Around it, a large rounded rectangle with a sky-blue outline labelled at its top-left 'Harness'. Inside the harness, arranged evenly around the model in a ring, eight small rounded part cards, each with a bold name and one short grey line under it: 'System prompt' / 'role, rules, today's date'; 'Message history' / 'everything said and observed'; 'Tool registry' / '15 tools from the toolbox'; 'The loop' / 'call model, run tools, repeat'; 'Stop rules' / 'answer, max steps, loop guard'; 'Budget' / 'tokens and steps per message'; 'Error recovery' / 'read next_step, do not repeat'; 'State store' / 'saved between days'. A ninth card at the right edge outside the harness, connected by a dashed line: 'Human' / 'confirms and approves'. Below the harness, a wide flat box 'Toolbox over MCP', and below that a wide flat box with light ember fill 'Bahi ERP 7.2'. Arrows: from the harness down to the toolbox, from the toolbox down to Bahi.

A wide 16:9 flowchart of a control graph for a purchase order. Labels as plain text, no brackets. A straight horizontal spine across the middle of eight rounded boxes in sky blue joined by thick arrows, left to right: 'Understand', 'Look up', 'Preview', 'Confirm', 'Raise request', 'Wait for approval', 'Create order', 'Release'. Between 'Look up' and 'Preview' there is a small diamond 'gates'. From the diamond, three thin dashed arrows go up to three detour boxes above the spine in light ember: 'Supplier not in master: hold', 'No food-grade certificate: ask, cite policy 6.2', 'Cost centre closed: ask for an open one'. The 'Wait for approval' box has a small pause symbol and a label above it 'paused until Rohit approves'. Below 'Understand' a thin arrow goes down to a separate box in light grey 'Question: free loop with read-only tools'. After 'Release' a box 'Reply from the receipt'. A small legend in the bottom-right: 'spine = always runs', 'detour = only when its gate is true'.

A wide 16:9 timeline figure of one purchase job spread over several days. Labels as plain text, no brackets. A thin horizontal time axis across the lower middle with five tick labels: 'Day 1, morning', 'Day 1, afternoon', 'a minute later', 'Day 5', 'Day 8'. Above the axis, a row of rounded event boxes aligned to the ticks: at 'Day 1, morning' a sky-blue box 'Kavita asks; request PR/2026/04417 raised'; then a long grey dashed bar spanning to 'Day 1, afternoon' labelled 'paused: state saved, waiting for Rohit'; at 'Day 1, afternoon' a box 'Rohit approves in his inbox'; at 'a minute later' a sky-blue box 'harness reads Bahi, resumes: PO/2026/01182 created and released'; at 'Day 5' a box 'Neha records GRN/2026/30001, 12,000'; at 'Day 8' a green box 'GRN/2026/30002, 8,000: order closed'. Below the axis, a flat wide box spanning the full width labelled 'state store: messages, documents, waiting on whom' with small thin arrows up to each event box, showing it is saved and read at every step. Every tick label must be spelled exactly: Day 1, morning / Day 1, afternoon / a minute later / Day 5 / Day 8.
